name: Warfarin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: NSAIDs (celecoxib, diclofenac, ibuprofen, indomethacin, ketorolac, mefenamic acid, naproxen, piroxicam and others)
CYP2C9 inhibitors (amiodarone, capecitabine, co-trimoxazole, fluconazole, metronidazole, miconazole, voriconazole)
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR closely when starting, stopping or changing the dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP3A4 inhibitors (amiodarone, amlodipine, atorvastatin, cimetidine, ciprofloxacin, clarithromycin, cyclosporine, diltiazem, erythromycin, fluconazole, itraconazole, ketoconazole, ritonavir and others)
key_interactions.effect: May raise warfarin exposure and INR (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR closely when starting, stopping or changing the dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP inducers (carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, rifampin, bosentan, efavirenz, prednisone)
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR closely when starting or stopping the inducer.
Monitor INR closely when starting or stopping any antibiotic or antifungal.

key_interactions.effect: Some cause bleeding or change warfarin effect (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR more often when starting or stopping a botanical.
